“For it is like a man, going into another country, who called his own servants, and entrusted his goods to them.
“They said to him, ‘Lord, he has ten minas!’
‘For I tell you that to everyone who has, will more be given; but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has…
However what does the Scripture say? “Throw out the servant and her son, for the son of the servant will not inherit…
So then, brothers, we are not children of a servant, but of the free woman.

translations.web: But if he gives of his inheritance a gift to one of his servants, it shall be his to the year of liberty; then it shall return to the prince; but as for his inheritance, it shall be for his sons.
translations.bsb: But if he gives a gift from his inheritance to one of his servants, it will belong to that servant until the year of freedom; then it will revert to the prince. His inheritance belongs only to his sons; it shall be theirs.
